question: PT Usha clocked a timing of 55.42 sec in 400-metre hurdles at which of the following Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1984 Los Angeles**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PT Usha** clocked a timing of **55.42 sec** in the **400-metre hurdles** at the **1984 Los Angeles Olympic Games**.
 
• This performance earned her the nickname "Payyoli Express" and she narrowly missed a medal, finishing fourth in the event.
 
• PT Usha's timing was just 1/100th of a second behind the bronze medalist, making it one of the closest finishes in Olympic history.
 
• Her performance at the 1984 Olympics brought her widespread recognition and established her as one of India's greatest athletes.
 
• She has been a significant figure in Indian athletics and has inspired many young athletes in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PT Usha**, also known as Pilavullakandi Thekkeparambil Usha, was born on **June 27, 1964**, in the state of Kerala, India.
 
• She has won numerous national and international medals throughout her career, including multiple gold medals at the Asian Games and Asian Championships.
 
• PT Usha was awarded the **Arjuna Award** in 1983 and the **Padma Shri** in 1985 for her contributions to Indian sports.
 
• After retiring from competitive athletics, she established the **Usha School of Athletics** in Kerala to train young athletes.
 
• Her dedication to the sport and her achievements have made her an enduring icon in Indian athletics.
